text: Read; both landed. (a) understand-purpose names write, answer and waiting, and says a session writes a draft and never the card. (b) The schema's reading row takes gap_reason. (c) The schema's description says the paragraph, the science task, the destination and the goal's lists carry no bare number and that the stage refuses one; a schema cannot say it better and the stage is where it is enforced. Round two of the bundles, run 20261116-3 at 4a2cb1d, collection collect-1 in the log folder (sessions 1caad302 in echo-0005 and 29f477cd in rheo-fixture-0004; files on this computer, not a record): none of the eight faults of v5 came back. The echo session found nothing unclear and kept the tool's output as CLAUDE.md says; the rheometer session named --record's records, the statuses, the units of temperature and gap, and that the grade table is not carried. What it still met, for the next template version and not for a build now: in CLAUDE.md's list of what the agent never does, an empty item (a bare dash) stands between two lines; CAPABILITIES.json says the changing tools are behind the bundle's gate while none is in the bundle, which reads as a contradiction until the not_here mark is understood; a skill's applies_to names lab_rheometer and nothing in the bundle says the fixture instrument is one. Both sessions were opened through the application by this seat, so each was also given the application's instructions for such a session, and the rheometer session read a note an earlier run's session had left in the application's shared notes folder; that leak ends when sessions are run from the command line. Nothing is asked of you now. This seat removes run 20261116-3 and its sessions.
